hypothesis: R266 等权 A 腿有正收益，但净 P&L 集中度 C2-C4 失败。保持策略信号、10 仓上限、历史成分、撮合、成本和窗口全部不变，只将持仓方式改为系统已支持的 score_weight；检验评分加权是否能在保留收益的同时改善风险调整和头部贡献。引擎还对单票仓位设有等权目标上限，因此不能凭名称推断实际效果。

gates.P1: R266 equal-weight control cache hashes match finalized R266 evidence, and its curve passes R265 parity
gates.P2: strategy and all four referenced factors are present after running-panel reload, with zero strategy load errors
gates.G1: candidate 3x return is positive and retains at least 70% of the R266 equal-weight return
gates.G2: candidate maximum drawdown is no worse than -25%
gates.G3: candidate rolling one-year positive-return rate is at least 70%
gates.G5: validation annualized return is at least 5%
gates.R1: candidate full-sample Sharpe is no lower than equal-weight control
gates.R2: candidate maximum drawdown is no worse than equal-weight control by more than 3 percentage points
gates.C2: largest symbol net P&L share is at most 25%
gates.C3: top three symbols net P&L share is at most 55%
gates.C4: top five symbols net P&L share is at most 75%
gates.C5: at least 8 distinct symbols have positive validation P&L
gates.C6: largest industry gross-profit share is at most 45%
gates.C7: largest single-symbol loss is at most 20% of gross profit

diagnostics_not_gates: For control and candidate, report top-1/top-3/top-5 shares using gross-profit denominator alongside registered net-P&L shares.
Report net-to-gross profit ratio to quantify how much gross profit is consumed by losses.
These alternate-denominator diagnostics do not replace or relax C2-C4.
decision_rule: P/G/R/C 全部通过才进入下一阶段纸面观察研究；任何失败均不采纳。读取结果后不得改变仓位方式、持仓数、成本、窗口或门槛。
known_limitations: The strategy was studied previously; discovery and validation are not independent.
The experiment reuses existing engine sizing behavior and does not add a portfolio risk model.
The score_weight implementation caps each position at the equal-weight target, so it may leave cash uninvested.
Industry classification is the current snapshot, not historical point-in-time data.
The strategy can hold for up to 35 trading days and has no fixed stop loss.
Panel registration and a passing backtest would not by themselves authorize production deployment.
